title: Employee sees own annual balance, and a first-year employee sees zero
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka E-0142 has entitled 12, used 4, remaining 8 for 2026. Sinta joined 1 March 2026 and has no approved leave.
test_data: Raka Putra E-0142. Sinta, hire date 2026-03-01.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka and open the balance. 2. Sign out. 3. Sign in as Sinta and open the balance.
expected_result: Raka sees entitled 12, used 4, remaining 8, and does not see Sinta or Wulan. Sinta sees entitled 0 and remaining 0.

title: Supervisor approval of two annual days deducts 2
requirement_ids: FR-04 FR-05 FR-06 FR-07 FR-09 FR-10 BR-02 BR-04 BR-06 BRQ-02 BRQ-04
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka has remaining 8. He has no request that overlaps 8-9 December 2026. Dimas is his supervisor.
test_data: Annual leave 8 December 2026 through 9 December 2026. Comment on approval: Covered by Sinta.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka and submit the request. 2. Record the working-day count and the status. 3. Sign in as Dimas, open the department calendar, and approve with the comment. 4. Sign in as Raka and read the balance and the notification.
expected_result: After submit, status is Submitted, working days are 2, and remaining is still 8. After approval, status is Approved, remaining is 6, and Raka can see the comment. The request does not go to HR.

title: Eleven working days are refused and the balance does not change
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka has remaining 8. The fixture holiday list has no holiday from 1 December through 15 December 2026.
test_data: Annual leave 1 December 2026 through 15 December 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka. 2. Enter the dates and attempt to submit.
expected_result: Submit is refused for insufficient annual balance. The request stays Draft. Remaining stays 8. Dimas has no new notification.

title: Annual leave on the next working day is refused
preconditions: Today is Wednesday 18 November 2026. Raka has remaining 8.
test_data: Annual leave starting 19 November 2026 and ending 19 November 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka. 2. Attempt to submit the request.
expected_result: Submit is refused under the three-working-day notice rule. The earliest start date shown is 23 November 2026. The request stays Draft. Remaining stays 8.

title: Two sick days without a file are refused
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka is signed in. No file is attached.
test_data: Sick leave 18 November 2026 through 19 November 2026.
steps: 1. Enter the sick-leave dates. 2. Leave the attachment empty. 3. Attempt to submit.
expected_result: Submit is refused. Status is Draft or the request is not submitted. No approver is notified.

title: Sick leave with a file does not deduct annual balance
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka has remaining 8.
test_data: Sick leave 18 November 2026 through 19 November 2026. Attachment catatan-dokter.pdf containing the sentence UAT fixture, not a medical document.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka and submit the request with the file. 2. Read the remaining balance.
expected_result: Status is Submitted. Remaining annual balance is still 8.

title: Four annual days stay with HR after the supervisor approves
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka has remaining 8. No overlapping request.
test_data: Annual leave 8 December 2026 through 11 December 2026.
steps: 1. Raka submits. 2. Record the working-day count. 3. Dimas approves with a comment. 4. Raka reads his balance. 5. Retno opens the HR queue.
expected_result: Working days are 4. After Dimas approves, status is Pending HR, not Approved. Remaining is still 8. The request is in Retno's queue.

title: HR rejection leaves the balance unchanged
preconditions: The request from a fresh run of the TC-07 setup is Pending HR. Raka's remaining balance is 8.
test_data: Comment: Too close to the client go-live.
steps: 1. Sign in as Retno. 2. Reject the Pending HR request with the comment. 3. Sign in as Raka.
expected_result: Status is Rejected. Remaining is 8. Raka can see the comment.

title: Supervisor rejection requires a comment and does not deduct
preconditions: Raka has a Submitted annual request for 8-9 December 2026. Remaining is 8. This request is not the one used for TC-02.
test_data: Attempted empty comment, then comment: Client workshop that week.
steps: 1. Sign in as Dimas. 2. Try to reject with an empty comment. 3. Reject with the comment. 4. Sign in as Raka.
expected_result: The empty comment is refused and the status stays Submitted. After the comment, status is Rejected, remaining is 8, and Raka can see the comment.

title: A returned request can be resubmitted to the supervisor
preconditions: Dimas has Returned Raka's annual request with the comment Move it off the workshop week. Remaining is 8.
test_data: New dates 15 December 2026 through 16 December 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka and read the return comment. 2. Change the dates and resubmit. 3. Sign in as Dimas.
expected_result: Status is Submitted. Dimas is notified and the request is in his queue, not in the HR queue. The previous comment is still visible. Remaining is 8.

title: An overlapping date is refused
preconditions: Raka has Approved annual leave on 8 December 2026 and 9 December 2026.
test_data: A second annual request for 9 December 2026 only.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka. 2. Attempt to submit the second request.
expected_result: Submit is refused because of the overlap. The approved request is unchanged.

title: Finance blackout dates are refused for annual leave
preconditions: Wulan is in Finance. Remaining annual balance is 10. Blackout includes 28 and 29 December 2026.
test_data: Annual leave 28 December 2026 through 29 December 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Wulan. 2. Attempt to submit.
expected_result: Submit is refused because the dates fall in a blackout. No supervisor notification. Balance unchanged.

title: Friday afternoon deducts 0.5 and the calendar shows afternoon
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka has remaining 8. 11 December 2026 is a working Friday in the fixture.
test_data: Annual leave, afternoon of 11 December 2026.
steps: 1. Raka submits the half day. 2. Record the working-day count. 3. Dimas approves. 4. Raka reads the balance. 5. Dimas opens the Operations calendar.
expected_result: Working days are 0.5. Status becomes Approved without HR. Remaining is 7.5. The calendar shows Raka as afternoon only. Sick leave does not offer a half-day choice: confirm the control is absent on a new sick request.

title: Cancelling future approved leave restores the balance
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka has Approved annual leave for 8-9 December 2026 and remaining 6, which is the result of approving a 2-day request from a starting balance of 8.
test_data: The approved request above.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka and cancel the request. 2. Read the balance. 3. Dimas opens the Operations calendar for those dates.
expected_result: Status is Cancelled. Remaining is 8. The calendar no longer shows Raka on those dates.

title: The supervisor cannot see a sick-leave file or reason
preconditions: Raka has Submitted sick leave for 18-19 November 2026 with catatan-dokter.pdf and a reason text. Dimas is his supervisor.
test_data: The request from the TC-06 setup, or a fresh one with the same file.
steps: 1. Sign in as Dimas and open the request. 2. Using Dimas's session, request the attachment address directly.
expected_result: Dimas sees type Sick and the dates. He does not see the reason or the file. The direct request does not return the file.

title: A balance adjustment without a comment is refused
preconditions: Retno is signed in as HR Admin. Raka's remaining balance is known and recorded in the actual result before the attempt.
test_data: Adjustment of plus 1 day, comment left empty.
steps: 1. Attempt to save the adjustment with an empty comment. 2. Read the balance again.
expected_result: The adjustment is not saved. The balance is unchanged.

title: December export includes approved dates and omits drafts
preconditions: Raka has Approved annual leave on 8 and 9 December 2026, and a Draft on 15 December 2026.
test_data: Export month December 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Retno. 2. Export December 2026. 3. Open the CSV.
expected_result: There is a row for Raka on 8 December 2026 and on 9 December 2026 with status Approved. There is no row for 15 December 2026. Columns are employee_id, employee_name, department, leave_type, date, half_day, status.

title: Department calendar shows approved leave for that department only
preconditions: Raka has Approved annual leave on 8-9 December 2026. He also has a Draft on 15 December 2026. Wulan has Approved annual leave on 10 December 2026.
test_data: Operations calendar, December 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Dimas and open the Operations calendar. 2. Look at 8, 9, 10, and 15 December.
expected_result: 8 and 9 December show Raka with type Annual. 15 December does not show the draft. 10 December does not show Wulan.

title: Cuti bersama deducts once for an eligible employee
preconditions: Raka is eligible and has remaining 8. Dates 20 March 2026 and 23 March 2026 are on the calendar as cuti bersama. He has no existing cuti bersama on those dates.
test_data: Department Operations. Comment prefix Cuti bersama 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Retno and run cuti bersama for those dates and Operations. 2. Read Raka's balance and requests. 3. Run the same dates again. 4. Read the balance.
expected_result: After the first run, Raka has an Approved cuti bersama request and remaining 6. After the second run, remaining is still 6 and there is not a second request.

title: One unpaid day still waits for HR
preconditions: Raka has remaining 8. No overlapping request.
test_data: Unpaid leave for 8 December 2026 only.
steps: 1. Raka submits. 2. Dimas approves. 3. Read the status and the balance.
expected_result: Status is Pending HR. Remaining is still 8. The request is not Approved.

title: A published holiday is excluded from the working-day count
preconditions: Today is 18 November 2026. Raka is in Operations, not Finance, so the Finance blackout does not apply. 25 December 2026 is a public holiday. Raka has remaining 8.
test_data: Annual leave 24 December 2026 through 31 December 2026.
steps: 1. Sign in as Raka. 2. Enter the dates and read the working-day count before submitting. 3. Submit.
expected_result: The count is 5, not 8. The excluded dates are 25 December (holiday) and 26-27 December (weekend). Submit is accepted because 5 is within the remaining 8. Status is Submitted and the balance is still 8.

title: A Google account that is not an employee cannot sign in
preconditions: Staging SSO is enabled. The test Google account is not on the employee list.
test_data: The non-employee account named in the UAT plan.
steps: 1. Attempt to sign in with that account. 2. Attempt to open the balance page.
expected_result: No session is created. The balance page is not shown.
